---
title: "Aire · Calidad del aire"
lang: es
---

```{python}
#| label: datos-base
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

files = sorted(Path("../lake/serving/indicador_diario").glob("fecha=*/indicador_diario.parquet"))
df = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(f) for f in files], ignore_index=True) if files else pd.DataFrame()
ult = df["fecha"].max() if not df.empty else "s/d"
base = df[df["fecha"] == ult].copy() if not df.empty else df

def f1(x, dec=1):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:.{dec}f}"
```

```{python}
#| label: hero
#| output: asis
print(f"""<div class="hero hero-aire">
<h1>Calidad del aire</h1>
<p>PM2.5 · PM10 · O₃ · NO₂ (CAMS/Copernicus) · {ult} · {len(base)} puntos</p>
</div>""")
```

```{python}
#| label: kpis
#| output: asis
pm = base["pm25_media"].dropna()
lat = base[base["region"] == "LatAm"]["pm25_media"].dropna()
sobre = base[base["pm25_media"] > 35.4].shape[0]
pmax = base.loc[base["pm25_media"].idxmax()] if not pm.empty else None

def card(valor, unidad, etiqueta):
    return (f'<div class="kpi kpi-aire"><div class="kpi-valor">{valor}'
            f'<span class="kpi-unidad">{unidad}</span></div>'
            f'<div class="kpi-etiqueta">{etiqueta}</div></div>')

cards = [
    card(f1(pm.median()), "µg/m³", "PM2.5 mediana · global"),
    card(f1(lat.median()), "µg/m³", "PM2.5 mediana · LatAm"),
    card(str(sobre), "puntos", "Sobre 35.4 µg/m³ (límite diario laxo)"),
    card(f1(pmax["pm25_media"]) if pmax is not None else "s/d", "µg/m³", f'Peor punto · {pmax["ciudad"]}' if pmax is not None else "Peor punto"),
]
print('<div class="kpi-row">' + "".join(cards) + "</div>")
```

## Visor de PM2.5

Color por categoría OMS 2021, tamaño por concentración.

```{python}
#| label: visor-aire
#| fig-cap: "PM2.5 por punto (bandas AQI EPA; línea de referencia: guía OMS 24h ≤ 15 µg/m³)"
import folium
from folium.plugins import MarkerCluster, Fullscreen

ESRI_SAT = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
OMS = {"Buena": "#2d6a4f", "Moderada": "#ee9b00", "Dañina (sensible)": "#ca6702",
       "Dañina": "#bb3e03", "Muy dañina": "#9d0208", "Peligrosa": "#6a040f"}

m = folium.Map(location=[-12, -62], zoom_start=3, tiles=None, control_scale=True)
folium.TileLayer("OpenStreetMap", name="Calles OSM").add_to(m)
folium.TileLayer(tiles=ESRI_SAT, attr="Esri", name="Satélite").add_to(m)
mc = MarkerCluster(name="PM2.5").add_to(m)
for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).iterrows():
    folium.CircleMarker(
        [p["lat"], p["lon"]], radius=4 + min(float(p["pm25_media"]), 150) / 18,
        color=OMS.get(p["categoria_pm25_aqi"], "#6c757d"), fill=True, fill_opacity=0.85,
        tooltip=f"{p['ciudad']}: {p['pm25_media']:.1f} µg/m³ ({p['categoria_pm25_aqi']})",
        popup=folium.Popup(
            f"<b>{p['ciudad']}</b> ({p['pais']})<table>"
            f"<tr><td>PM2.5</td><td><b>{p['pm25_media']:.1f} µg/m³</b></td></tr>"
            f"<tr><td>PM10</td><td><b>{f1(p['pm10_media'])} µg/m³</b></td></tr>"
            f"<tr><td>O₃</td><td><b>{f1(p['o3_media'])} µg/m³</b></td></tr>"
            f"<tr><td>NO₂</td><td><b>{f1(p['no2_media'])} µg/m³</b></td></tr></table>",
            max_width=280),
    ).add_to(mc)
legend = ("<div style='position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:20px;z-index:9999;background:white;"
          "padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px' class='map-legend'><b>PM2.5 (AQI EE. UU.)</b><br>" +
          "".join(f"<span style='color:{c}'>●</span> {k}<br>" for k, c in OMS.items()) + "</div>")
m.get_root().html.add_child(folium.Element(legend))
Fullscreen().add_to(m)
folium.LayerControl(collapsed=False).add_to(m)
m
```

## Análisis

```{python}
#| label: graficos-aire
import plotly.express as px

top = base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).sort_values("pm25_media", ascending=False).head(20)
fig1 = px.bar(top, x="pm25_media", y="ciudad", color="categoria_pm25_aqi",
              color_discrete_map=OMS, title="Top 20 PM2.5 (µg/m³) · bandas AQI (EPA)",
              labels={"pm25_media": "PM2.5 media", "ciudad": "Ciudad"})
fig1.add_vline(x=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
fig1.update_layout(height=560)
fig1.show()

fig2 = px.histogram(base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]), x="pm25_media", color="region",
                    nbins=30, title="Distribución de PM2.5 por región",
                    labels={"pm25_media": "PM2.5 µg/m³"})
fig2.add_vline(x=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
fig2.update_layout(height=380)
fig2.show()
```

> Bandas de color: breakpoints del AQI (EPA EE. UU.). Línea verde: guía OMS 2021 (PM2.5 24h ≤ 15 µg/m³). Bandas calculadas en `src/transform/indicadores.py`.
